newsitem.title: USA: AGP chairman, president charged with fraud.
newsitem.headline: AGP chairman, president charged with fraud.

text.p: AGP and Co Inc said Thursday that Steven Bingaman, its chairman and president, has been charged with conspiracy to commit securities fraud.
Bingaman has not been indicted, the company said.
He was charged last week in a complaint filed by the U.S. Attorneys Office in the Southern District of New York.
The complaint accuses Bingaman and another person of agreeing to pay an undercover agent posing as a broker if the agent would have customers buy over-the-counter shares of another company, AGP said.
AGP said Bingaman was arrested October 10 and released the same day on bond.
The Securities and Exchange Commission has filed a cease-and-desist order against Bingaman based upon the allegations, AGP said.
